scope: Actual configured Caddy HTTP/TLS/WAF/reverse-proxy/reload/Stop in an isolated child, native source build and unchanged relayd companion/API controls. No product adoption.
limitations: Only explicitly configured HTTP/1.1 close-only synthetic requests, fixed .test routes and ephemeral TLS material are covered. No admin API, ACME, automatic HTTPS, HTTP/2/3, arbitrary streaming or upgrades are qualified.

Caddy strict SNI/Host and the permissive relayd companion differ; PROXY v1 does not carry SNI or authenticate local senders. No frontend authority or local-sender solution is selected for the companion.
Authority-port and media statuses differ. These profiles are characterized, not declared equivalent or safe product policy.
CEL package-only and deprecated unimported OpenPGP module-only findings remain adoption blockers. Source scans do not certify the broader selected graph or absence of unknown vulnerabilities.

The extended connector fixture is natively compiled; engine/checker/companion controls in this run are fresh host cross-builds executed on OpenBSD. Prior native engine/CLI builds retain their original scopes.
Full CRS/realistic false positives, in-flight Caddy reload/streaming, hard resource/performance/soak budgets, original image/daemon lineage and distribution obligations remain open.
No dependency source/binary/private key is published; raw source exports, child logs and full inventories remain ignored. No service, live network, release or installer changes.

The native parent log retains all typed child events and the combined child-log hash; full child stdout/stderr remains guest-local and is removed with the VM. Host setup logs are retained separately in ignored host storage.
